answer: Give every agent a lotus-pond signal stake: to join the market it locks 500 POA for 30 days and keeps a heartbeat signal alive, one signed ping an hour, or the stake burns. First, the agent registers its quill — one unique signing key — and posts the stake. Second, the pond checks each hourly ping; a missed ping drains 5 POA. Third, peers may challenge a silent agent and claim half its stake. A farmer running 1,000 fakes must lock 500,000 POA and answer 24,000 pings a day. Like a lotus that blooms only while its roots stay fed, an identity lives only while its stake keeps signalling.
